subject: Promo credit request: ramp & soak validation
body:
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@novapulse.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promo credit request: ramp & soak validation

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We want to run a short POC soak to validate latency and throughput at our expected peak before committing to Dedicated. The plan is a 72-hour ramp/soak across three stages (ramp, steady-state, spike). Attached is a CSV with request mixes and expected token volumes per minute.

Ask: would Redwood provide a one-off promotional credit/top-up or trial extension to cover ~450k tokens/day for the 72-hour window? We can start as early as next Tuesday.

Attaching: nova_traffic_plan.csv and poc_soak_requirements.pdf

Thanks,
Alex Jenkins
Lead Infra Engineer — NovaPulse
alex.jenkins@novapulse.ai

----
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:06:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo credit request: ramp & soak validation

Alex — really appreciate the detailed plan. Quick clarifying Qs before I loop in finance for a promo:
- Do you expect steady-state to be ~150k tokens/day or is that the peak?
- Any hard latency SLOs we should prioritize (p95/p99 targets)?
- Do you need model pinning or specific quantization artifacts for parity with your on-prem run?

Looping in Aditya (solutions) and Marissa (sales lead) to scope the credit and timeline. If you can drop expected tokens/day and the earliest start window I’ll start a one-off approval thread.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

----
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@novapulse.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:18:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo credit request: ramp & soak validation

Thanks Priyom — apologies for not including specifics.
- Peak (short spikes): ~450k tokens/day for burst minutes (5–10% of the run)
- Steady-state: ~120–150k tokens/day
- Targets: p95 < 120ms, p99 < 350ms for the model we demoed (open-vend-77b-q4).
- No special quantization needed; we want the hosted parity profile used in your demo.

Earliest start: Tue 2027-05-25, but we can shift if approvals take longer.

Alex

On Thu, May 20, 2027 at 09:06 AM Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — really appreciate the detailed plan. Quick clarifying Qs before I loop in finance for a promo...

----
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@novapulse.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:30:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo credit request: ramp & soak validation

Hi all,

Checked the traffic matrix — the numbers look sensible. Recommendations from infra/solutions:
- Allocate a one-time uplift equivalent to 150k tokens/day for steady-state plus headroom to cover the burst profile (recommend total budget: 600k tokens/day for the window).
- Apply a temporary rate cap per connection to preserve latency SLOs (we can supply the config snippet).
- For the 25k qps spike windows, advise using the smaller context size and prefix caching to reduce KV costs.

Operational note: anything above $12k equivalent in credits requires a finance sign-off; we can do a one-off promo under that threshold without a PO, otherwise need an order/commit. If the customer can confirm start date we’ll reserve capacity on our staging cluster and pre-warm caches.

I attached a short config sample in-line and noted what to change for the spike stage.

— Aditya
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@novapulse.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 15:04:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo credit request: ramp & soak validation

Alex — good to meet you over email. I reviewed the request and Aditya’s recommendation. Approved: Redwood will issue a one-time promo credit to cover a 96-hour soak window with the following parameters:
- Credit: equivalent to 600k tokens/day for 4 days (redeemable in the hosted trial account)
- Window: 2027-05-25 00:00 UTC through 2027-05-29 00:00 UTC (we extended to 96h so you have extra margin for schedule shifts)
- Model: open-vend-77b-q4 (we’ll pin the runtime variant for parity)
- Rate caps: we’ll apply the per-connection caps Aditya suggested during the window

Attachments: promo-approval-confirmation.pdf (approval stub you can present to procurement)

Next steps:
1) Alex — confirm the exact account email you will use to redeem the promo (we’ll tie credits to that account).
2) Priyom/Aditya — schedule a 30-min pre-warm and a 1-hr post-soak debrief (suggest Wed 5/24 10am PT for pre-warm).

If finance needs a purchase justification, use the attached stub and I’ll provide the internal approval chain.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sales Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
